old_problem: The visual criterion was valid but the source did not identify the physical Ethernet connector, hardware-revision LED legend, controlled linked-idle/activity fixture, image/video quality or restoration. Software carrier and counters cannot establish green color or solid-versus-blinking behavior.
disposition_reason: ED-09 assigns the physical observation to a qualified person and ED-08 requires actual visual evidence. The exact connector, link partner, traffic stimulus and evidence path are safe runtime/project bindings under ED-03, so the case remains Manual Only but no longer needs an Engineering Decision Pending state.

Accepted DeepSeek's manual boundary while strengthening target identity, reproducible idle/activity states, visual proof and software corroboration.
Retained solid-green link-up, blinking-green activity, Ethernet-only scope, 10-minute allocations and physical evidence; no InfiniBand result is substituted.

test_case.test_name: Mapped BlueField Ethernet solid/blinking green physical LED check
test_case.purpose: Visually prove the exact BlueField Ethernet connector shows solid green for a stable link and blinking green during controlled Ethernet activity, with target-bound software state only as corroboration.
required_package: BlueField Ethernet netdev/MAC/BDF/physical connector and switch/peer map
Hardware-revision LED legend defining link and activity indicators
Approved Ethernet link partner and bounded traffic generator
Qualified operator/witness and timestamped photo/video method with sufficient frame rate/exposure
Maintenance window, protected evidence location and original-fixture restoration plan
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator verifies the mapped physical Ethernet connector, establishes a stable linked-idle condition and records solid-green visual evidence, then applies approved bounded Ethernet traffic and records a timestamped sequence proving blinking green; correlate each state with the exact netdev carrier/counters and restore the original link/traffic fixture. Do not use InfiniBand state or software telemetry as visual proof.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped Ethernet port displays solid green while linked with no activity and visibly blinking green during the controlled traffic interval; software carrier/counters corroborate the exact state and timestamps; no wrong port or unexpected network impact occurs and final link/fixture state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires direct operator visual evidence for both color/pattern states on the mapped connector plus fixture and timestamp provenance. Carrier, ethtool, counters, InfiniBand state or a still image that cannot demonstrate blinking cannot pass alone.
safety_gate: Verify the exact Ethernet connector and link partner before any traffic or cable action
Qualified operator performs physical observation; do not disturb unmapped/production/sole-management links
Use bounded approved Ethernet traffic and preserve network/platform logs
Stop on wrong port, link loss, unexpected traffic impact or ambiguous visual evidence; restore the original fixture and do not retry automatically
expected_evidence: Ethernet netdev/MAC/BDF/physical/switch/peer map and LED legend
Linked-idle fixture plus timestamped solid-green photo
Activity fixture plus timestamped video/sequence proving blinking green
Preserved logs and restored link/fixture state
test_case.recovery: On wrong-port action or link impact, stop traffic, restore the documented original cable/switch/peer state, verify carrier/address/routes and services, preserve evidence and escalate. Do not use an InfiniBand or OOB recovery result as substitute Ethernet coverage.

blocked.reason: The two states, human activity, evidence and recovery are complete; connector/fixture/operator values are execution prerequisites.
